notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Released! Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
List of bugs fixed and improvements made (7/25/2020):

 No more bugs or freezing during the second part of Event 7s in the Gallery,
 Achievements should now properly unlock if you were to watch an event in a Gallery due to missing one from a prior bug in version 1.0. 


We will strive to fix any problems and make any requested improvements as more people play our game! If you have any suggestions, please either post them in the Community Hub or send us a longer, more detailed email at touchme@tittaptingle.com.

Enjoy your stay at Chikubijima!

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Released! Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
List of bugs fixed and improvements made (7/24/2020):

 Brittney's Level 7 scene no longer crashes at 'Oh-'
 Scarlet's Level 7 scene no longer contains mysterious blank portraits.
 Scarlet's Level 4 scene no longer contains mysterious blank portraits.
 Ying Yue's events and Karine's events were swapped in the gallery before -- they aren't now
 Achievements for Ying Yue and Scarlet should work no problem now. Run by them again in the Gallery if you need to reclaim a potentially missed achievement
 Fullscreen and windowed modes can now be chosen from in the Options menu


We will strive to fix any problems and make any requested improvements as more people play our game! If you have any suggestions, please either post them in the Community Hub or send us a longer, more detailed email at touchme@tittaptingle.com. 

Enjoy your stay at Chikubijima!
